focus-outer.$description: Focus ring color: the ink, so it contrasts with any ground or surface.

focus-inner.$description: Focus ring gap: the page ground, between the element and the ring.

info.$description: Informational tone (info alerts, tags and badges). Defaults to the link color.

info-tint.$description: Background for informational messages and tags.

accent-1.$description: Category color 1 of 8: avatars, colored tags and badges, navigation icons and chart series. Neutral in the default theme; colorful presets (Prismatic) give each its own hue.

ring.$description: The focus ring (DESIGN.md): a 1px gap in the ground color and a 1px ink ring. Redeclared per theme so a themed subtree resolves its own colors.

ring-inset.$description: The same ring drawn inside the element, for rows and cells that sit flush in a scrolling container.
